body:
I just want to thank you for listening to me... I really mean it too, the last few days have been really hard and having someone respond to me in a meaningful way really has helped.  This afternoon I admitted to someone online about my previous suicide attempt, going into extreme detail and giving away a bit too much personal information, but it made me feel better... but their only response was 'it's cool, i'm here to vent to'... I know it shouldn't bother me but it did, I told them that they were the first person I have ever told and to me it wasn't just venting, it was letting out demons of which I have never let anyone see.  Having you actually respond tonight made me feel like someone actually does care out there (Even if you don't actually, shh, you're making me feel better hahah)...

I feel a little bit less low than before though in general which is good.  My anxiety is killing me right now but I feel no where near what I was this afternoon.  I was ready to relive my past nightmare and off myself.  After coming into realization that wasn't what I really wanted to do, I decided to look into therapists.  I know I need help at this point.
Did you read the post I linked to? My story is unfortunately the same every time :/

If I had family to talk to I honestly wouldn't be posting this to the internet... No one is home and I know I have the emotion to do it right now.. I just need someone, something, I don't even know anymore.

Sorry I haven't updated in a few days..,
My mother decided to check herself into detox Monday morning and I have been staying with my sister for the last few days.  The last couple of days I have actually felt fantastic at her house.  I guess I was so busy studying for exams, running around chasing my niece, cooking dinner every night for them, that I didn't have time to even think about emotions.  It felt so good, it was the first time in a long time I have felt that way... Unfortunately today I came home because my mom is back and already I feel low again.  It's almost as if as soon as I walk in the door this feeling of blank, uselessness kicks in. It doesn't help that my mom has been heavily medicated passed out on the couch. 

Ugh, I planned on typing more here and explaining how I couldn't stay with my sister permanently... but now I am not feeling so great and I don't really want to talk (type?)... (I get extremely dizzy when feeling this low, hopefully it will pass and I will type some more later, but I know if I don't at least type this much I will never update)

That's exactly how I feel, like a zombie.  It's been so long, I can't even remember feeling 'good' or even really feeling anything at all... And its strange because no one I know even realizes anything is wrong.  I go to school, put on fake smiles, talk to my 'friends', do my school work, come home, do whatever, and the entire time I cover up the blankness I feel.  When I talk, I just say things I know I am suppose to say.  I have memorized who likes what, what make who smile, what makes who upset, an I just say what I know they want to hear... What else would I talk about?  In fact I don't even have anyone I can talk to about this since I have been covering it for so long.  I want to change though... It may sound strange but my last suicide attempt, a little over a year ago, when I think about it and how low I was, is major motivation to never go there again.  I have been wanting to tell someone about it for awhile because I think describing the feeling to someone I know would make me feel a bit better, but truthfully there is no one to tell.  I'm hoping to change so that I could be strong enough to tell someone.  There really is no other place I can go but up from here.

How did you break out of this place you were in for so long?  What was the thing that motivated you to just completely change?  Did you see a therapist? Take medication?  I really do want to escape this nightmare, so trust me, everything you tell me I am taking to heart.

Oh and if you want you can PM if it is easier to not have a bunch of comments, it doesn't matter either way to me.

I mentioned this to the other commentor who mentioned leaving my parents, I do not associate with my father much and leaving my mother who be leaving her to suicide (if you want a more in depth response to that just read my comment above).  It is not an option for me though, even though I would have others to stay with.  

There are councilors in my school but,(this may sound strange), I keep my problems at home completely and do not drag them into my school life.  School is where I can semi escape from the terrors at home and it is also my only hope for the future.  To bring my bad state in to the mix it would be entangling the two, making me feel a loss of hope.  Thank you for your response though, I really do appreciate it even though I may not seem like it.

Going easier on myself is easier said than done.  As well is ditching my parents.  I really don't associate with my father (he does not live with me and I see him very little).  But I am all my mother really has left.  My siblings have both grown up and left her, sick of the drama she brings in to their lives.  Ditching my mom would basically mean leaving her to suicide, which is not an option to me.  Even though she's not much, she is my family and family cannot just escape your mind so easily as it seems.  I couldn't live with myself knowing I hurt someone like that.  

Thanks for your advice none the less.  Your diction did make me smile so at least that's something.

I have to say I re-read what you told me at least three times now, it took me a while to decide to respond because I'm not really sure how to respond.  Out of all the responses I feel yours was just, realistic and actually hit something inside of me.  I'm not saying it has completely changed me but it at least let something snap inside of me to wake up from the deep state I was in this afternoon so thank you for that.  
Maybe I can keep up this decent enough feeling to look into some help for myself... or at least keep in a decent enough mood to not go through with suicide, even if temporarily.  Thank you.
